launch_cutline.description: An M5 public-contract family carries a Stable (or LTS) contract claim only when every required contract form (JSON Schema, WIT, OpenAPI, Markdown summary, example payloads, and migration notes), its validator suite, and its release-packet linkage are published. A family that is missing any required publication evidence must narrow below the cutline rather than inherit an adjacent published family's claim.

stop_rules.title: JSON Schema unpublished
stop_rules.rationale: A public-contract family put forward at the cutline must publish its JSON Schema before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: WIT world unpublished
stop_rules.rationale: A family whose contract form is a WIT world must publish its WIT package before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: OpenAPI spec unpublished
stop_rules.rationale: A family whose contract form is an OpenAPI family must publish its OpenAPI spec before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: Markdown summary unpublished
stop_rules.rationale: A family put forward at the cutline must publish a Markdown contract summary before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: Example payloads unpublished
stop_rules.rationale: A family put forward at the cutline must publish example payloads before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: Migration notes unpublished
stop_rules.rationale: A family put forward at the cutline must publish migration/deprecation notes before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: Validator suite unwired
stop_rules.rationale: A family put forward at the cutline must wire a validator suite before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

stop_rules.title: Release packet unlinked
stop_rules.rationale: A family put forward at the cutline must link a release packet (claim manifest, qualification row, or evidence index) before it can carry a Stable contract claim.

rows.title: Command descriptors and invocation sessions

rows.rationale: The command-descriptor contract publishes its schema, summary, examples, migration notes, and validator suite and is release-linked, so it holds its Stable contract claim.

rows.title: Optional service API and browser-handoff family

promotion.rationale: Promotion is held because public-contract stop rules are firing on families put forward at the cutline whose required contract forms, validator suite, migration notes, or release linkage are unpublished.
